create_UnaryUnary_blocking_call: create a UnaryUnary multi-callable to invoke a unary-unary gRPC method with a blocking response
create_UnaryUnary_with_call: create a UnaryUnary multi-callable to invoke a unary-unary gRPC method and return call details
create_UnaryUnary_future: create a UnaryUnary multi-callable to invoke a unary-unary gRPC method and return a future
create_UnaryStream_call: create a UnaryStream multi-callable to invoke a unary-stream gRPC method returning a response iterator
create_StreamUnary_blocking_call: create a StreamUnary multi-callable to invoke a stream-unary gRPC method with a blocking response
